messages:
maya: Heads-up — after the gateway upgrade in apac-gpu we started seeing a big drop in reconstructed traces for inference requests. spans stop at the gateway, runtime never gets parent span.

dmitri: saw same for a handful of customer sessions, 30-40% of traces missing downstream spans. suspect header rewrite at the proxy or our otel-agent not honoring incoming trace headers. :eyes:

ashley: relevant prometheus alert fired: trace_reconstruction_failures_total spiked. sre-bot reported it at 1765554400.

sre-bot: Alert: trace_reconstruction_failures_total > 50 in apac-gpu (last 5m). firing -> paging on-call.

maya: quick check — nginx-ingress was on an old sidecar config that strips unknown headers by default. also saw our node pool autoscaler was resizing while request routing was in-flight which might hide spans due to connection re-use.

jorge: can we preserve W3C headers at the edge? we should forward `traceparent` and `tracestate` and prevent header normalization.

ashley: minimal Envoy snippet that worked in staging for header forwarding:

```yaml
route:
  request_headers_to_add:
    - header:
        key: traceparent
        value: "%REQ(traceparent)%"
    - header:
        key: tracestate
        value: "%REQ(tracestate)%"
  include_request_headers_in_envoy_logs: true
```

dmitri: also verify otel SDK config on the runtime side — if SDK is configured with `propagation=b3` but gateway sends W3C, we lose context. we have mixed propagators in older services.

maya: here's what we found in runtime pod logs: `2026-02-28T11:12:33Z warn otel-propagation: incoming traceparent missing; starting new root`

maya: kubectl logs snippet from otel-gateway-0:

```
I0328 11:11:22.123 otel-gw info: incoming headers: {host: inference.redwood, traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01}
I0328 11:11:22.124 otel-gw warn: forwarded header dropped by egress proxy: tracestate
```

ashley: so two problems: (1) egress/egress-proxy config stripping tracestate and sometimes traceparent on retries, (2) SDK propagator mismatch in some runtime replicas.

jorge: operational plan: 1) update edge proxy config to explicitly forward the W3C set, 2) add a compatibility propagator chain to runtimes (w3c,b3), 3) add short-term sampling tweak to reduce trace volume for GPU-heavy models.

dmitri: about sampling — if we keep 100% tracing for large multimodal jobs we blow budget and create high-cardinality metrics. propose dynamic sampler: 100% for low-qps control plane calls, 1-2% for heavy inference per-model streams, and 10% for error traces.

ashley: agree. also we've got a Prometheus problem: some instrumentation libraries put span_id/trace_id into labels and that explodes series cardinality. we need to scrub those attributes before they become metrics.

maya: note for dashboards: SLOs should be by model-version per-region (apac-gpu/eu-gpu/us-gpu) p95/p99 latency and trace-success-rate. add a panel for sampling-adjusted cost estimate (tokens * sampling-rate -> estimated spans).

observability-team: I'll take the dashboard change. will add an alert: trace-success-rate < 90% for 10m -> warn; < 75% -> page. include capacity tag so we only page on dedicated clusters.

sre-bot: Action created: OTEL-1263 preserve-w3c-in-apac-proxy assigned to dmitri. Priority: P1.

dmitri: can someone run a quick egress-proxy dry-run? small envoy filter to add headers and not mutate existing ones. i'll push patch to canary namespace.

maya: pushed canary filter to apac-canary, logs show `request_headers_to_add` applied and tracer logs now show incoming parent ids. preliminary: trace_reconstruction_failures_total dropped from 38% -> 4% in canary traffic. :tada:

ashley: great. next: rollout to apac-gpu for edge proxies, and patch runtime images to use `propagators=["tracecontext","b3"]` where we saw mismatch. also add a scrubber rule in the exporter pipeline to drop span/trace ids from prometheus labels.

jorge: one caveat — autoscaler resets connections during scale-up spikes; even with headers preserved some spans will still be orphaned. we should add a short-lived retry policy that preserves trace headers across retries.

maya: agreed. I'll open OTEL-1264 for retry/header-preserve, marking as lower-risk change.

dmitri: timeline? canary -> monitor 30m -> roll 50% -> 100% over 2h unless regressions. set prometheus alert thresholds relaxed during rollout.

ashley: cost note for leadership: enabling full tracing everywhere (apac-gpu training/inference) would increase our daily span throughput ~6x and tracing storage costs ~3x. proposed default: sampled traces + targeted 100% for error/rollback paths. I'll prepare a short deck.

maya: deployed to prod apac edge proxies at 1765554920, initial telemetry looks good. trace-success-rate went to 93% but p99 tail still has a few gaps on heavy-batch jobs.

observability-team: monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/apac/otel-inference (will add panels and runbook).

jorge: thanks team, next steps captured in OTEL-1263/1264 and OBS-42 for dashboard. please add any missing testcases to the QA checklist (propagation across gateway, retry preservation, propagator mismatch).

maya: ok closing the loop here — ping if you see any regression. :+1:
